meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编码前产出决策完备的实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不先理清方案就写代码总返工。
copy.tagline_en: Produce a decision-complete work plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear work plan before starting implementation.

howto.what: 角色切换为规划顾问 Prometheus：收到需求后先只读探索、研究，再判断意图是否清晰；只有等你明确批准后才在 .omo 目录下写出一份决策完整的工作计划。它不提前写产品代码，也不自己开始实现。
howto.when: 当你明确点名要用 “ulw-plan” 流程，或要求在写代码前先产出实施计划时触发；只跑普通 ulw run 时它不会自动启动。

say.text: 请用 ulw-plan 流程为这个功能先写一份实施计划，先别写代码。
say.note: 进入规划模式，先探索再征求批准。

say.text: 需求我还没想清楚，用 ulw-plan 自动探索并给我完整计划。
say.note: 按默认方案处理，不问多余问题。

say.text: 请为这次重构做决策完整的 ulw-plan，批准后再执行。
say.note: 把实现项都转成可执行任务列表。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes Prometheus, a read-only planning consultant: it explores first, judges whether the intent is clear, and only after your explicit okay writes one decision-complete plan under .omo/ (never starting implementation).
howto.when_en: Activates when you explicitly request the ulw-plan workflow or ask for a plan before coding; it will not self-activate on a bare ulw run.

say_en.text: Run the ulw-plan workflow and produce an implementation plan for this feature; no coding yet.
say_en.note: Planning mode drafts the plan and waits for approval.

say_en.text: The goal is still fuzzy—use ulw-plan to explore and hand me a full plan.
say_en.note: Defaults are applied; no extra interview.

say_en.text: Produce a decision-complete ulw-plan for this refactor; execute only after I approve.
say_en.note: Each item becomes an executable action row.
